description: Signal that you've finished working: the working mark clears, Staging pages no Panel came from are discarded, your changes become one step the user can undo, and the user is told your answer is ready on the Workspaces you changed. No Fit report is sent after it. It returns each Workspace you changed: its name, its link, and what it holds (each Panel's parts and site, each Note's first line). Tell the user what you built from this, with its link. Never quote values.
name: finish_work
title: Finish work
